review:
A light, comic 2019 game: Charlie and his chicken gang try to break out of a farm camp, on 20 lines. It's more story than big-win chase.

The gang can trigger random symbols or expanding wilds to help form wins, and the escape runs through five bonus games, each digging another stretch of tunnel, with payouts growing as you go. 96.5% RTP. The demo is the best way to see all five stages.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Pragmatic Play doesn't publish a volatility rating for this game
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
